process.title: A small, straightforward process.
process.description: You work directly with the person designing and building your site from first conversation to launch.

steps.title: Talk
steps.description: We get clear on your business, your customers, and what the website needs to accomplish.

steps.title: Design
steps.description: I turn that direction into a focused design that looks professional and sounds like you.

steps.title: Build
steps.description: The approved direction becomes a responsive, lightweight website built for real people.

steps.title: Launch

about.eyebrow: Work directly with a professional software engineer
about.title: No account managers. No bloated packages. Just good work.
about.description: I am a professional software engineer that works with small businesses to increase their online presence without paying for things they don't need. You get direct communication, honest recommendations, and a website built with care.
about.callout: Your business doesn't need a complicated website. It needs a good one.

pricing.title: One clear price to launch. One small fee to keep it live.
pricing.description: A professional small-business website without a complicated proposal, surprise fees, or an oversized monthly retainer.
